transcript: Father: Yaar aaj phir ek simple sa kaam reh gaya. [Man, today again a simple task was left incomplete.] Son: Kya hua papa? [What happened, dad?] Father: Bank gaya tha. Bas kuch account details poochhni thi. Lekin wahan English mein baat karni padi aur phir main atak gaya. Is age mein English kaise seekhunga? [I went to the bank. Just had to ask some account details. But had to speak in English there and then I got stuck. How will I learn English at this age?] Son: Bas itni si baat? Aap SpeakX try karo. [Just this? You try SpeakX.] Father: SpeakX? [SpeakX?] Son: SpeakX mein AI teacher hai. Aap usse bilkul waise hi baat kar sakte ho jaise kisi real insaan se karte ho. [SpeakX has an AI teacher. You can talk to her just like you talk to a real human.] AI Teacher: I would like some information about opening an account. Father: I would like some information about opening an account. Son: Hindi mein poocho aur English mein bolna seekho. Yahan AI teacher bol-bol ke English seekhati hai. Sirf Rs 2 mein 7 din ka trial bhi hai. Toh app download karo aur aaj hi practice shuru karo. [Ask in Hindi and learn to speak in English. Here the AI teacher teaches English by speaking. There is also a 7-day trial for just Rs 2. So download the app and start practicing today.]
on_screen_text: Yaar Aaj Phir Kaam Rah Gaya [Man, today again work was left incomplete] Kya Hua Paapa [What happened, dad?] Bank Gaya Tha [I went to the bank] Lekin Vaha English Mein Baat Karni Padi Aur Phir Atak Gaya [But had to speak in English there and then got stuck] Is Age Mein English Kaise Sikhunga [How will I learn English at this age] Speakx Try Karo [Try SpeakX] Speakx Mein AI Teacher Hai [SpeakX has an AI teacher] I Would Like Some Information About Opening An Account. Hindi Mein Pucho Aur English Mein Bolna Sikho [Ask in Hindi and learn to speak in English] Yaha AI Teacher Bol Bol Ke English Sikhati Hai [Here AI teacher teaches English by speaking] Sirf Rs 2 Mein Saat Din Ka Trial Bhi Hai [There is also a 7-day trial for just Rs 2] To App Download Karo Aur Aaj He Practice Shuru Karo [So download the app and start practicing today]
summary: A father shares his frustration about failing to complete bank tasks due to his inability to speak English. His son introduces him to the SpeakX app, showcasing its interactive AI teacher that helps users practice English. The ad promotes a 7-day trial for just Rs 2.
